<style>
/* Insights pagination: the grid fades out and back in, the cards come in one after another (see the list script in this footer) */
.ins-grid{transition:opacity .2s ease}
.ins-grid.is-out{opacity:0}
.ins-grid_item.ins-in{animation:insIn .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--ins-i,0) * 45ms)}
@keyframes insIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ins-grid{transition:none}.ins-grid_item.ins-in{animation:none}}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  /* Insights list: category filter, search and pagination (9 per page) over the native CMS list.
     Changing page: the grid fades out while the page scrolls back to the list, the new cards' images are already loaded
     (every thumbnail is fetched in the background once the page is idle), then the cards come in one after another.
     The grid keeps its height during the swap so nothing below it jumps. */
  function run(){
    var root=document.querySelector('[data-ins-list]');if(!root){return;}
    var grid=root.querySelector('.ins-grid');
    var PER=9,page=1,cat='',q='';
    var reduce=!!(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
    function txt(el,sel){var n=el.querySelector(sel);return n?n.textContent.trim():'';}
    var data=grid?[].slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.ins-grid_item')).map(function(it,i){return {el:it,title:txt(it,'h3'),cat:txt(it,'.blog-card_cat'),author:txt(it,'.blog-author_name'),date:Date.parse(txt(it,'.blog-card_date'))||0,i:i};}):[];
    data.sort(function(a,b){return (b.date-a.date)||(a.i-b.i);});
    data.forEach(function(d){grid.appendChild(d.el);});
    function nameOf(b){var t='';[].forEach.call(b.childNodes,function(c){if(!(c.classList&&c.classList.contains('ins-filter_order'))){t+=c.textContent;}});return t.trim();}
    var fl=root.querySelector('.ins-filter_list');
    var btns=fl?[].slice.call(fl.querySelectorAll('.ins-filter_btn')):[];
    btns.sort(function(a,b){var x=parseFloat(txt(a,'.ins-filter_order')),y=parseFloat(txt(b,'.ins-filter_order'));return (isNaN(x)?99:x)-(isNaN(y)?99:y);});
    btns.forEach(function(b){fl.appendChild(b);});
    var hasAll=btns.some(function(b){return /^all$/i.test(nameOf(b));});
    if(fl&&!hasAll){var a=document.createElement('div');a.className='ins-filter_btn';a.textContent='All';fl.insertBefore(a,fl.firstChild);btns.unshift(a);}
    btns.forEach(function(b){var n=nameOf(b);b.setAttribute('data-cat',/^all$/i.test(n)?'':n);b.setAttribute('role','button');b.setAttribute('tabindex','0');
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){setCat(b.getAttribute('data-cat'));});
      b.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();setCat(b.getAttribute('data-cat'));}});});
    function setCat(c){c=c||'';if(c===cat&&page===1){return;}cat=c;page=1;swap(false);}
    var input=root.querySelector('[data-ins-search]');var tmr;
    if(input){input.addEventListener('input',function(){clearTimeout(tmr);tmr=setTimeout(function(){q=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();page=1;render();},150);});}
    var pag=root.querySelector('[data-ins-pagination]');var empty=root.querySelector('.ins-empty');
    function filtered(){return data.filter(function(d){if(cat&&d.cat.toLowerCase()!==cat.toLowerCase()){return false;}if(q&&(d.title+' '+d.cat+' '+d.author).toLowerCase().indexOf(q)===-1){return false;}return true;});}
    function pageList(n){var a=[],i;if(n<=7){for(i=1;i<=n;i++){a.push(i);}return a;}var start=Math.max(2,page-1),end=Math.min(n-1,page+1);if(page<=3){start=2;end=4;}if(page>=n-2){start=n-3;end=n-1;}a.push(1);if(start>2){a.push('gap');}for(i=start;i<=end;i++){a.push(i);}if(end<n-1){a.push('gap');}a.push(n);return a;}
    function arrow(left){return '<svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="'+(left?'M12.5 4.5L7 10l5.5 5.5':'M7.5 4.5L13 10l-5.5 5.5')+'" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>';}
    function mk(cls,html,label){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className=cls;b.innerHTML=html;b.setAttribute('aria-label',label);return b;}
    function go(p){if(p===page){return;}page=p;swap(true);}
    function buildPag(n){if(!pag){return;}pag.innerHTML='';if(n<=1){pag.style.display='none';return;}pag.style.display='';
      var prev=mk('ins-page_arrow is-prev',arrow(true),'Previous page');prev.disabled=page===1;prev.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page-1);});
      var nums=document.createElement('div');nums.className='ins-page_nums';
      pageList(n).forEach(function(p){if(p==='gap'){var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='ins-page_gap';s.textContent='...';nums.appendChild(s);return;}
        var b=mk('ins-page_num'+(p===page?' is-active':''),String(p),'Page '+p);if(p===page){b.setAttribute('aria-current','page');}b.addEventListener('click',function(){go(p);});nums.appendChild(b);});
      var next=mk('ins-page_arrow is-next',arrow(false),'Next page');next.disabled=page===n;next.addEventListener('click',function(){go(page+1);});
      pag.appendChild(prev);pag.appendChild(nums);pag.appendChild(next);}
    function render(){var list=filtered();var n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(list.length/PER));if(page>n){page=n;}
      var show=list.slice((page-1)*PER,page*PER);
      data.forEach(function(d){d.el.style.display='none';d.el.classList.remove('ins-in');});
      show.forEach(function(d){d.el.style.display='';});
      btns.forEach(function(b){var on=(b.getAttribute('data-cat')||'')===cat;b.classList.toggle('is-active',on);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');});
      if(empty){empty.style.display=list.length?'none':'block';}
      buildPag(n);return show;}
    /* wait (at most ~0.35s) for the new cards' images, so they appear complete instead of popping in */
    function ready(items,ms){var imgs=[];items.forEach(function(d){[].forEach.call(d.el.querySelectorAll('img'),function(im){im.loading='eager';imgs.push(im);});});
      var all=Promise.all(imgs.map(function(im){var p=im.complete?Promise.resolve():new Promise(function(r){im.addEventListener('load',r,{once:true});im.addEventListener('error',r,{once:true});});
        return p.then(function(){return im.decode?im.decode().catch(function(){}):null;});}));
      return Promise.race([all,new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);})]);}
    function toList(){var top=root.getBoundingClientRect().top;if(top<0||top>window.innerHeight*.6){window.scrollTo({top:top+window.pageYOffset-80,behavior:reduce?'auto':'smooth'});}}
    var token=0,T=0;
    function swap(scroll){
      if(reduce||!grid||!('Promise' in window)){render();if(scroll){toList();}return;}
      var my=++token;clearTimeout(T);
      if(!grid.style.minHeight){grid.style.minHeight=grid.offsetHeight+'px';}
      grid.classList.add('is-out');
      if(scroll){toList();}
      T=setTimeout(function(){
        if(my!==token){return;}
        var show=render();
        ready(show,350).then(function(){
          if(my!==token){return;}
          show.forEach(function(d,i){d.el.style.setProperty('--ins-i',i);d.el.classList.add('ins-in');});
          grid.classList.remove('is-out');
          setTimeout(function(){if(my===token){grid.style.minHeight='';}},700);
        });
      },200);
    }
    render();
    /* fetch every thumbnail in the background once the page is idle, so later pages open with their images ready */
    function warm(){data.forEach(function(d){[].forEach.call(d.el.querySelectorAll('img'),function(im){im.loading='eager';});});}
    function idle(){if('requestIdleCallback' in window){requestIdleCallback(warm,{timeout:3000});}else{setTimeout(warm,1500);}}
    if(document.readyState==='complete'){idle();}else{window.addEventListener('load',idle);}
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading'){document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);}else{run();}
})();
</script>
<script>(function(){var s=document.currentScript;var root=(s&&s.closest)?s.closest('[data-ins-featured]'):null;if(!root){root=document.querySelector('[data-ins-featured]');}if(!root){return;}function init(){var items=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.ins-featured_item')).filter(function(i){return !i.classList.contains('w-condition-invisible');});if(!items.length){root.style.display='none';return;}var dots=root.querySelector('[data-ins-dots]');var cur=0,timer=null;var reduce=window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;function show(n){cur=(n+items.length)%items.length;items.forEach(function(it,i){var on=i===cur;it.classList.toggle('is-active',on);it.setAttribute('aria-hidden',on?'false':'true');var a=it.querySelector('a');if(a){a.setAttribute('tabindex',on?'0':'-1');}});if(dots){[].forEach.call(dots.children,function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('is-active',i===cur);d.setAttribute('aria-current',i===cur?'true':'false');});}}function restart(){clearInterval(timer);if(items.length>1&&!reduce){timer=setInterval(function(){show(cur+1);},6000);}}if(dots){dots.innerHTML='';if(items.length>1){items.forEach(function(_,i){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='ins-feat-dot';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Show featured insight '+(i+1));b.addEventListener('click',function(){show(i);restart();});dots.appendChild(b);});}}root.addEventListener('focusin',function(e){var kb=true;try{kb=e.target.matches(':focus-visible');}catch(err){}if(kb){clearInterval(timer);}});root.addEventListener('focusout',function(e){if(!root.contains(e.relatedTarget)){restart();}});root.classList.add('is-ready');show(0);restart();}init();})();</script>
